label: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Seen creators only (the 23 non-development seen creators, tier L). Cue counts: sense not resolved, precision unknown (no reader). Model-coded voice labels, not checked by a person; agreement, never accuracy.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
reading: Most lists cannot be computed on the 23 non-development creators (49 of 67 classes thin).
